race.description: Kosciuszko Tickets Close Midnight Tonight Mdn Hcp
race.comment: SARMAT (1) resumes from a lengthy break. Carved out good figures on debut when came from near last on the turn for a slashing third over 1181m at this track from the outside gate. Ran fifth in a recent trial over 940m at Grafton. Has a host of gear changes and will be strong late. DARK MODE (2) winkers go on for this at his third race start from the rails draw. Worked hard early from the sticky gate with a tiring eighth over 1300m at the Sunshine Coast. Can race a touch closer and play a leading role. QUI ROUGE (10) improving mare who looks set for a good prep after savaging the line for a tidy third over 1000m at Tuncurry. Only has to hold that from to go close. PRESTIGE EXOTIC (7) blinkers go on for this after making his debut with a respectable fourth over 1025m at this track. Ready for this trip and worth thought.
